def test_user_address_card_management():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={"username": username, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)

    address_data = {
        "city": "City", "country": "Country", "number": "123", 
        "postcode": "12345", "street": "Street", "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    added_address = next((a for a in addresses if a.get("id") == address_id), None)
    assert added_address is not None
    assert added_address.get("city") == "City"
    assert added_address.get("country") == "Country"

    card_data = {
        "ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    added_card = next((c for c in cards if c.get("id") == card_id), None)
    assert added_card is not None
    assert added_card.get("expires") == "12/25"
    assert added_card.get("longNum").endswith("3456")
    assert "1234567890" not in added_card.get("longNum")

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in addresses)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert not any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

def test_catalogue_retrieval():

def test_carts_management():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    if not items:
        pytest.skip("No items in catalogue")
    item_id = items[0]["id"]

    item_data = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": 10.5}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    added_item = resp.json()
    assert added_item.get("itemId") == item_id
    assert added_item.get("quantity") == 2

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert any(i["itemId"] == item_id and i["quantity"] == 2 for i in cart_items)

    item_data["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_merge():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    cat_resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert cat_resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {cat_resp.status_code}: {cat_resp.text}"
    items = cat_resp.json()
    if not items:
        pytest.skip("No catalogue items")
    item_id = items[0]["id"]

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json={"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 10.0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), timeout=10)

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert any(i["itemId"] == item_id for i in resp.json())

    bad_session = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={bad_session}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    assert auths[-1]["authorised"] == auth.get("authorised")

def test_user_register_login_conflict():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer = resp.json()
    assert customer.get("username") == username
    assert customer.get("firstName") == "Test"
    assert customer.get("lastName") == "User"
    assert customer.get("email") == f"{username}@example.com"
    assert "password" not in customer

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
